steps.eval: (async () => { const J = {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-Gigg-CSRF': '1'}; const post = async (u, b) => (await fetch('/api/v1' + u, {method: 'POST', headers: J, body: JSON.stringify(b)})).json(); const p = await post('/projects/1/gigs', {title: 'Small wins: release 0.3', priority: 3}); const s = await post('/projects/1/gigs', {title: 'Small wins: write the notes', parent_id: p.id, blocks_parent: true}); await post('/gigs/' + p.id + '/attachments/link', {kind: 'link', value: 'https://example.com/spec', label: 'spec'}); await post('/workspaces/1/templates', {name: 'Small wins release', title: 'Release', checklist: ['tag'], subgigs: [{title: 'Write notes'}, {title: 'Tag build', blocks_parent: true}]}); await post('/workspaces/1/fields', {name: 'Alpha', kind: 'text'}); await post('/workspaces/1/fields', {name: 'Beta', kind: 'text'}); const r = await post('/projects/1/recurrences', {title: 'Small wins: daily report', freq: 'daily', tz: 'UTC', window_start: '23:00', window_minutes: 60}); localStorage.setItem('sw', JSON.stringify({p: p.id, pk: p.key, s: s.id, r: r.id})); return [p.key, s.parent_key, r.created_count]; })()
